subject.title: feat(ui): always-on chat title bar with inline rename and workspace actions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the always-on chat header and the new operator.admin workspace-reveal RPC as the permanent Control UI direction once the scoping and error defects are fixed?
rationale: This is a broad, always-visible UX change plus a new public gateway operation; correctness fixes are mechanical, but accepting that permanent product and protocol surface requires owner intent.

options.title: Land after targeted fixes
options.body: Keep the proposed architecture, repair selected-agent scoping and visible error reporting, resolve conflicts, and rerun focused live proof.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Land the always-on header and inline rename while deferring workspace reveal and its gateway API to a smaller follow-up.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Close or redesign the branch if an always-visible header or host-side reveal operation is not desired product behavior.

recommendation.title: Land after targeted fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed architecture, repair selected-agent scoping and visible error reporting, resolve conflicts, and rerun focused live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available product and implementation owner for the affected Control UI and gateway surfaces.
